title: Audio-Technica ATH-M50x
description: Industry-standard closed-back studio monitor headphones with exceptional clarity, deep bass, and excellent isolation. Wired with a detachable cable (includes coiled and straight options). A go-to for tracking and mixing on a budget.

title: Beyerdynamic DT 770 Pro (250 Ohm)
description: Closed-back reference headphones with a wide, detailed soundstage and excellent comfort for long sessions. Wired with a non-detachable coiled cable. Ideal for tracking and mixing in untreated rooms.

title: AKG K240 Studio
description: Semi-open back headphones offering a natural, spacious sound at an unbeatable price. Wired with a detachable mini-XLR cable. A classic studio workhorse for recording and critical listening.

title: Sony MDR-7506
description: Legendary closed-back headphones trusted by broadcast and recording studios worldwide for decades. Wired with a non-detachable coiled cable. Flat response and rugged build at an affordable price.

title: Beyerdynamic DT 900 Pro X
description: Open-back studio headphones with a detailed, transparent sound ideal for critical mixing and mastering. Wired with a detachable mini-XLR cable. Comfortable velour earpads for extended sessions.

title: Sennheiser HD 650
description: Open-back audiophile headphones renowned for their smooth, natural frequency response. Wired with a detachable cable (proprietary two-pin connector). A mastering and mix-referencing favorite among engineers.

title: AKG K712 Pro
description: Open-back reference headphones with a wide soundstage and precise imaging. Wired with a detachable mini-XLR cable. Excellent for mixing, mastering, and spatial audio work.

title: Shure SRH1540
description: Premium closed-back headphones with alcantara earpads and a spacious, detailed sound. Wired with a detachable cable (includes two straight cables). Exceptional isolation without sacrificing mix clarity.

title: Austrian Audio Hi-X65
description: Open-back professional headphones engineered by former AKG designers. Wired with a detachable cable (3.5mm jack on each earcup). Ultra-precise transient response and flat frequency curve for mixing and mastering.

title: Neumann NDH 30
description: Open-back studio headphones from the legendary microphone maker. Wired with a detachable cable (dual-sided entry). Designed to translate mixes like nearfield monitors with a flat, uncolored response.

title: Audeze LCD-X
description: Planar magnetic open-back headphones delivering extraordinary resolution and transient detail. Wired with a detachable cable (mini-XLR connectors on each earcup). Used by Grammy-winning engineers for mastering and critical listening.

title: Focal Clear Mg Professional
description: High-end open-back headphones with magnesium drivers offering unmatched dynamics and detail retrieval. Wired with a detachable cable (3.5mm jacks on each earcup). A reference-grade tool for mastering engineers.

title: Neumann NDH 20
description: Closed-back studio monitoring headphones with tight bass response and excellent isolation. Wired with a detachable cable (dual-sided entry). Perfect for tracking and mixing when open-backs aren't practical.

title: Sennheiser HD 560S
description: Affordable open-back headphones with a neutral, analytical sound signature. Wired with a detachable cable (single-sided entry, 3.5mm). An excellent entry point for home studio mixing and referencing.

title: Audio-Technica ATH-R70x
description: Ultra-lightweight open-back reference headphones with a pure, natural sound. Wired with a detachable cable (A2DC locking connectors). The wing-support headband design provides fatigue-free wearing for marathon mixing sessions.

title: Beyerdynamic DT 1990 Pro
description: Premium open-back studio headphones with Tesla driver technology for exceptional detail and dynamics. Wired with a detachable mini-XLR cable. Includes two sets of earpads for different tonal balances.

title: Sony MDR-M1
description: Sony's dedicated mixing headphone with a closed-back design optimized for studio use. Wired with a detachable cable (3.5mm locking connector). Neutral tuning with excellent transient response and tight low end.

title: Slate VSX Modeling Headphones
description: Closed-back headphones paired with software that models the acoustics of famous studios and monitoring systems. Wired with a non-detachable cable. Mix on headphones with the perception of mixing in a treated room.

title: Dan Clark Audio AEON 2 Noire
description: Planar magnetic closed-back headphones with a warm, detailed signature and remarkable isolation. Wired with a detachable cable (DPIN connector). Folds flat for portability — a traveling engineer's secret weapon.

title: HIFIMAN Sundara
description: Planar magnetic open-back headphones delivering audiophile-grade resolution at a mid-range price. Wired with a detachable cable (3.5mm jacks on each earcup). Incredibly fast transients and an airy soundstage for detailed mixing.

title: Austrian Audio Hi-X55
description: Closed-back studio headphones with Hi-X driver technology delivering tight bass and precise mids. Wired with a detachable cable (3.5mm jack on each earcup). Foldable design with memory foam earpads for comfort and portability.

title: Yamaha HPH-MT8
description: Closed-back studio monitor headphones with circumaural design and accurate frequency response. Wired with a detachable cable (includes coiled and straight options). Yamaha's studio heritage translated into a reliable tracking and mixing tool.

title: Sennheiser HD 800 S
description: Flagship open-back headphones with the widest soundstage in their class. Wired with a detachable cable (proprietary Sennheiser connectors on each earcup). Ring radiator drivers reveal every detail in a mix — the ultimate mastering reference.

title: Focal Spirit Professional
description: Closed-back studio headphones with Focal's signature clarity and dynamics. Wired with a detachable cable (single-sided 3.5mm entry). Memory foam earpads provide isolation for tracking while maintaining mix translation accuracy.
